source_packet.role: protocol and statistical analysis plan packet

semantic_batches.scope: question, design, eligibility, treatment, endpoints, verification, statistical plan, amendments, sponsor roles
CONSORT flow, follow-up, baseline population, enrichment, background therapy, treatment exposure
primary, component, secondary, further, subgroup, and sensitivity efficacy findings
author interpretation, limitations, funding, data availability

primary_article.representation: time-to-event component curves summarized with reported hazard ratios
prespecified subgroup forest plot summarized as exploratory consistency finding

supplementary_appendix.representation: HF hospitalization or CV death cumulative incidence
further endpoints; ICD/CRT hazard-ratio confidence interval retained as source inconsistency

visual_and_table_reconciliation.protocol_and_tsap: Full 239-page packet was text-extracted and low-resolution rendered. Final protocol amendment and final TSAP governed method reconciliation. The protocol packet was treated as supporting provenance for the same publication, not a separate study.

source_integrity_findings.finding: The ICD/CRT row reports HR 0.80 with 95% CI 1.58 to 1.10. The interval is internally impossible because the lower bound exceeds both the estimate and upper bound. The value was not silently corrected and was not promoted to a quantitative LiteratureAtom.

reference_handling.protocol_bibliographies: Used as supporting provenance only and not merged into the requested main-article references list.

omissions_and_reasons: Investigator and coordinator rosters were inspected but not atomized because they do not represent independently reviewable clinical assertions.
The bibliography was extracted separately and not atomized.
Every subgroup row was not converted to an atom. The source-level subgroup consistency claim and exploratory status were preserved instead.
The protocol and SAP were used for design, amendment, endpoint, and statistical provenance rather than exhaustive line-by-line atomization.
